candidate_name: Río Córdoba LNG regasification (Terminal Portuaria Río Córdoba)
sponsor_or_proposer: Sociedad Portuaria Río Córdoba S.A. (100% Colombian-owned port company)
current_state: Existing coal export terminal at Río Córdoba (Ciénaga, Magdalena) being converted to a multipurpose port (ANI 30-yr concession, ~US$82.8M). An ANLA environmental-license modification to INCORPORATE an LNG regasification project within the Terminal Portuaria Río Córdoba is currently UNDER ANLA REVIEW (in trámite as of 2026-06), alongside the Cayao expansion and Ciénaga LNG SAS applications.
missing_threshold_elements: Regasification-specific concrete commitment thin: capacity, FSRU vs land-based model, vessel, and start year for the LNG layer not yet published; the ANLA filing is a port modification rather than a dedicated LNG-terminal FID/award. Sponsor + location present, but the LNG component is at the application stage only.
watch_for: ANLA decision on the LNG-regasification incorporation; any capacity / FSRU charter / start-year disclosure; whether Río Córdoba becomes a distinct LNG terminal vs a feed point. NOTE: distinct from both the existing GEM 'Ciénaga FSRU' (Sociedad Portuaria Ciénaga LNG SAS) and the Drummond Ensenada de Alcatraz project — all three sit in Ciénaga, Magdalena.
notes: Lead URLs: El Heraldo (lists Río Córdoba among the THREE projects still under ANLA review); El Tiempo (Río Córdoba coal-to-multipurpose conversion, sponsor Sociedad Portuaria Río Córdoba S.A.) https://www.eltiempo.com/economia/sectores/sociedad-portuaria-rio-cordoba-transformara-terminal-de-carbon-en-puerto-multiproposito-en-cienaga-magdalena-3546982 (verified). Re-check ~Dec 2026.

candidate_name: EPM Copacabana regasification plant (Planta Satélite Regasificadora)
current_state: EPM building its own LNG regasification plant in Copacabana (Antioquia, inland north of Medellín); ~COP 300 billion investment, targeted to operate from mid-2026, to cover ~25% of EPM's gas customers.
missing_threshold_elements: LIKELY OUT OF GEM SCOPE: this is a Planta Satélite Regasificadora (PSR) rated 3,000 Nm3/h (~2.5 MMcf/d) — a small-scale, truck-fed satellite/peak-shaving regas plant feeding EPM's distribution network, NOT a marine LNG import terminal. EPM's own technical spec covers 'PSR GNL y EDS para GNL/GNC y sistema de transporte de GNC' (virtual-pipeline / trucked supply). Below the terminal threshold and not a coastal import facility.
watch_for: Whether EPM scales this into a marine import terminal or a larger facility; any reclassification. Otherwise treat as out-of-scope satellite plant and drop.
notes: Lead URLs: Valora Analítik (EPM Copacabana PSR, COP 300bn, 2026); El Colombiano 'La carrera por activar nuevas regasificadoras' (lists EPM Copacabana among players). Capacity 3,000 Nm3/h per Valora/El Colombiano coverage. Recorded for completeness; recommend NO add unless scope reinterpreted.
